reason: Tabelle 42 (p.118) 'Lüftungskanäle aus verzinktem Stahlblech' is the production balance of zinc-coated steel-sheet ventilation ducts per m2 — this dataset. It sits in the Herstellung block (Tab. 40-45); the identically named Tabelle 48 on p.120 belongs to the Entsorgung (disposal) block (Tab. 46-51) and is the wrong direction. Tabelle 43 is the stainless-steel duct and Tabelle 40 the spiral-seam pipe. Tabelle 37 (p.114) gives the sheet thickness (s = 0.75 mm) that identifies the variant; p.117 and p.119 are in range for the introducing text and any continuation.
